textVariants.text: Write a short note to your baby
textVariants.affirmation: It's a sweet keepsake to share when they're older 💞

textVariants.text: Tell your baby how much you love them
textVariants.affirmation: Talking to your baby can help you feel connected.

textVariants.text: Jot down a pregnancy memory
textVariants.affirmation: Hooray! Some day, you'll share these with your baby.

textVariants.text: Sing a little song to your baby
textVariants.affirmation: Your baby loves your voice (even if you can't sing).

textVariants.text: Tell your baby how your day's going
textVariants.affirmation: Your little pal loves hearing your voice.

textVariants.text: Read something aloud to your baby
textVariants.affirmation: Your baby is learning the sound of your voice.

textVariants.text: Hum a song to your baby
textVariants.affirmation: They can sense the vibrations – isn't that cool?

textVariants.text: Rub your belly for a bonding moment with your baby
textVariants.affirmation: Your baby can feel it – and may move in response.

textVariants.text: Hold your belly so your baby can sense your touch
textVariants.affirmation: You're bonding more every day!

textVariants.text: Take five deep breaths in and out
textVariants.affirmation: A little stress relief can help you and your baby.

textVariants.text: Name one thing that went well today
textVariants.affirmation: Expressing gratitude can help your mood 🧠

textVariants.text: Say something you're grateful for before bed
textVariants.affirmation: There's a lot to look forward to right now 👶

textVariants.text: Journal about how you're feeling (a sentence counts)
textVariants.affirmation: Whatever you're feeling is valid.

textVariants.text: Let yourself sit down and rest for a moment
textVariants.affirmation: Your body is doing a lot right now.

textVariants.text: Write down a worry to clear it from your head
textVariants.affirmation: Does your brain feel quieter now?

textVariants.text: Do a quick body scan for tension and release it
textVariants.affirmation: Ahhh ... that feels better.

textVariants.text: Treat yourself to something special today
textVariants.affirmation: You've earned it!

textVariants.text: Write down three things you're grateful for
textVariants.affirmation: Keeping regular gratitude lists is good for you.

textVariants.text: Say this mantra: "I know I can do this"
textVariants.affirmation: Yep, you can do it!

textVariants.text: Say this mantra: "I'm capable of amazing things"
textVariants.affirmation: You really are!

textVariants.text: Say this mantra: "My baby is safe and loved"
textVariants.affirmation: You've got this!

textVariants.text: Say this mantra: "I'm resilient, strong, and brave"
textVariants.affirmation: Yes you are!

textVariants.text: Say this mantra: "I'm doing the best I can"
textVariants.affirmation: It's okay if you're overwhelmed right now.

textVariants.text: Repeat this: "I'm proud of what my body's doing now"
textVariants.affirmation: You're growing a baby and a new organ: the placenta.

textVariants.text: Put your feet up and relax for at least five minutes
textVariants.affirmation: You took time for yourself *and* minimized swelling.

textVariants.text: Do five ankle circles with each foot
textVariants.affirmation: Ankle circles can keep blood flowing like it should.

textVariants.text: Do some shoulder rolls
textVariants.affirmation: Great work relieving those sore muscles.

textVariants.text: Take a stretch break
textVariants.affirmation: It all counts, even if you can't touch your toes.

textVariants.text: Indulge a craving
textVariants.affirmation: It's a pregnancy rite of passage 🍔

textVariants.text: Take a walk outside
textVariants.affirmation: Getting some fresh air can feel so good.

textVariants.text: Grab a healthy snack
textVariants.affirmation: Good job nourishing your baby!

textVariants.text: Get some steps in after a meal
textVariants.affirmation: Way to get moving 🙌

textVariants.text: Make plans with a friend
textVariants.affirmation: Yay! There's another thing to look forward to.

textVariants.text: Share an ultrasound photo with a loved one
textVariants.affirmation: Your village is just as excited as you are!

textVariants.text: Send a funny post to a friend
textVariants.affirmation: Way to brighten someone's day (and yours) ☀️

textVariants.text: List three people who could help when baby's here
textVariants.affirmation: Your village is there to support you.

textVariants.text: Text a friend and check in with them
textVariants.affirmation: Remember: You're not in this alone.

textVariants.text: Take today's vitamin
textVariants.affirmation: Dreading your prenatal? A different brand might help.

textVariants.text: Take your prenatal vitamin
textVariants.affirmation: Nice! Make it a daily habit during pregnancy.

textVariants.text: Take your daily prenatal
textVariants.affirmation: Done! You're already taking great care of your baby.

textVariants.text: Take today's prenatal vitamin
textVariants.affirmation: You did it! Even if it wasn't fun 🙃

textVariants.text: Pop your prenatal vitamin
textVariants.affirmation: Your future bestie says thanks!

textVariants.text: Take your prenatal (you’ll forget later 🙃)
textVariants.affirmation: That’s one less thing to remember now.

textVariants.text: Take your prenatal before you get distracted
textVariants.affirmation: Done! You've got enough on your plate already.

textVariants.text: Remember your prenatal vitamin today
textVariants.affirmation: Great! Now that's over with.

textVariants.text: Take a water break
textVariants.affirmation: Good job! Sipping throughout the day is good for you.

textVariants.text: Refill your water bottle
textVariants.affirmation: Good work! Aim for about 80 oz of fluids a day.

textVariants.text: Take a quick drink of water
textVariants.affirmation: 🎉 Staying hydrated is extra important right now.

textVariants.text: Take a hydration break
textVariants.affirmation: Woohoo! Every sip adds up.

textVariants.text: Take a few sips of water
textVariants.affirmation: Your body needed that.

textVariants.text: Grab your water bottle and take some sips
textVariants.affirmation: Hydration looks good on you 💁‍♀️

textVariants.text: Drink a quick glass of water
textVariants.affirmation: Your body's working hard – this helps.

textVariants.text: Keep sipping that water
textVariants.affirmation: Fluids help your body keep up right now.
